:1. `--api-key` — must be an `sk_` key. A `mcpjam_…` legacy key is a usage error.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:109:Every command
that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when it starts, before it contacts any
thing. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not an `http(s)` URL, or that carries credentials, a
query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables naming different servers. The error masks credenti
als, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved login is only sent to its own server: when it
is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before any request. `mcpjam cloud status` uses the sam
e checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok: false`, includes `credential.valid` / `deploym
ent.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informational (`credential.valid: null`) and successful.
\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:123:Empty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** selec
t a Cloud CLI project (it is SDK eval reporting only).\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:55:* **Author eval suites** — create
a runnable suite (name, default model, servers, test cases) synchronously and get a `suiteId` back; no run is started and no credi
ts are spent\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:58: usage, latency), and full traces. Runs appear live in the hosted UI,\n/wor
kspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:66: resources it created (eval suites), and token usage; the model is pinned\n/workspace/mcpjam-
eval/public-api.md:312:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations` | Per-iteration results: tool calls, token usage, latency (paginat
ed) |\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:332:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` history (`{role: \"u
ser\"\\|\"assistant\", content}` items, max 50 messages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-side and billed to t
he project. The turn can read project servers/suites/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs — kick those off yours
elf with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchronously with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made, `createdResources` (ids + app links),
and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \\~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**:
dedupe on your own trigger identity, and on an error response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost response, list s
uites) before retrying, or you'll create duplicates |\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:396:> The generation routes consume **
no customer credits** — the model cost is on\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:397:> MCPJam. They are still subject to usage l
imits, and each limit means a\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:399:> organization's daily generation quota (`429`, resets at
UTC midnight), and\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:403:> on every one: buying credits does not lift them, so do not retry in
a loop\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:412:| `POST .../goals/{goalId}/runs` | **Launch.** Answers `202` — the fan-out has s

a different actual split is a `409` (`details.code: swarm_funding_changed`) and nothing is created. The response can report `fund
ing` (`sponsored`, `credits`, `total`) |\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/public-api.md:419:* **Always send `Idempotency-Key` on a launch.*
